entries.description: Hallmarks cannot create, satisfy, copy or impersonate a contract permission.
Hallmarks cannot grant an effect, host capability or external-resource permission.
Hallmarks cannot expose, forge or dereference raw pointers.
Hallmarks cannot allocate, free, extend or transfer a flow-owned memory lifetime.
Hallmarks cannot prove alias isolation, mutation exclusion or collection-generation stability.
Hallmarks cannot remove a bounds check or authorize unchecked indexed access.
Hallmarks cannot grant, retarget or widen the flow-local verified-native checked-read-loop permission, or admit its direct path.
Hallmarks cannot issue, reuse or widen a Verified Object Kernel admission lease.
Hallmarks cannot turn a proof, proposal or receipt into reusable execution authority.
Hallmarks cannot sign, delegate, rotate or revoke cryptographic authority.
